name: Reverse Lunge with Overhead Reach
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and arms resting relaxed at your sides.
Step one foot backward into a deep, controlled lunge while simultaneously raising both arms straight overhead with palms facing inward.
Gently tuck your pelvis and hold the lunge while breathing into the stretch at the front of your back hip.
Lower your arms and step back to standing, then continue alternating sides.
tips: Keep your ribs tucked down rather than overarching your lower back as you reach overhead.
Take a long enough step back so your front heel stays firmly grounded.
